Name: Controdazone
Overview:
Controdazone! It’s "Control" + "The" + "Zone", get it?

This game is a twin stick shooter with a twist. Instead of killing your opponents you fight vigorously for control over the “zone”, a circular area that travels around the screen. Battle with up to 4 friends, or hone your skills against the bots. Grab power ups to give you an edge in battle.
